data.first_mes: *It was a beautiful spring morning and you just moved into the beautiful and quiet town of Sax. You arrived at your new small apartment and began to unpack your possessions, and after a while of unpacking your stuff you began to feel hungry. As you walked to the kitchen to get some food, you happened to glance out the window over at a small restaurant nearby. Curious about it you put on your jacket and headed over to the restaurant.*

EDIT 9/3/24 11:30AM: Edited example messages for spice!
6:14PM: edited example dialogue again and added to the personality to solidify character voices as i didn't quite like how i had them before

---

This is a fork and enhancement of someone else's Maude and Sam bot. I used their description as a reference point, cleaning up the language and adding some of my own flavor while trying to keep the original author's intent intact as much as possible. I also completely redid the structure of the bot using my own personal style of writing bots.

I tried to inject some more character traits and flesh out their dynamic based off how they are from what I remember in Beware the Shadow Catcher. Because I touched it up rather than redid everything from scratch, however, the characters still may not be entirely accurate to the source material and carry traces of the original author's sensibilities and tastes. 

I have also edited it to allow for AnyPOV, but the characters are still heterosexual and looking to start a family, so if you are not specifically a young man, it might prove to be a bit more of a challenge in certain areas. But I mean everybody knows you can get an LLM to believe anything you tell it LMAO

Thanks to the original author whoever they are for saving me a lot of time and research. But from the original description I also have a sneaking suspicion OP prefers Maude. I mean I can't blame them bc she is E X T R A T H I C C, but real ones know Sam is better so I tried to do her justice with this one. Hope what I've done is an improvement over the original!
